examples.text_zh: 他读了一篇关于那场旧战争的长篇大论。

examples.text_en: Her screed was full of words and no sense.
examples.text_zh: 她那篇长文全是废话，毫无意义。

examples.text_en: The old man read the scripture every day.
examples.text_zh: 那位老人每天读经文。

examples.text_en: They study the scripture at the old church.
examples.text_zh: 他们在老教堂里研究经文。

examples.text_en: She read the old scroll near the light.
examples.text_zh: 她在灯旁读那份旧卷轴。

examples.text_en: Please scroll down to the end of the page.
examples.text_zh: 请向下滚动到这一页的末尾。

examples.text_en: We must scrub the whole room today.
examples.text_zh: 我们今天必须把整个房间擦洗一遍。

examples.text_en: Please give the box a good scrub.
examples.text_zh: 请把那个盒子好好刷洗一下。

examples.text_en: The food was scrumptious and very good.
examples.text_zh: 这食物非常可口。

examples.text_en: That was a scrumptious thing to eat.
examples.text_zh: 那真是一种绝妙的美味。

examples.text_en: He had no scruple about the money.
examples.text_zh: 他对这笔钱毫无顾忌。

examples.text_en: She had a scruple about this kind of work.
examples.text_zh: 她对这种工作有所顾虑。

examples.text_en: He did the work scrupulously and on time.
examples.text_zh: 他一丝不苟地按时完成了工作。

examples.text_en: We check the food scrupulously every morning.
examples.text_zh: 我们每天早上都仔细检查食物。

examples.text_en: His words were scrutable to the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 他的话整个团队都能理解。

examples.text_en: This old book is scrutable to us.
examples.text_zh: 这本旧书我们能读懂。

examples.text_en: We must scrutinize this paper before we sign.
examples.text_zh: 签字前我们必须仔细检查这份文件。

examples.text_en: We will scrutinize the old food.
examples.text_zh: 医生会仔细检查这些旧食物。

examples.text_en: The work was under close scrutiny all day.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作一整天都受到严密检查。

examples.text_en: We need more scrutiny of this new plan.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要对这个新计划进行更多审查。
